headline.title: Why Tokyo is the most important tech destination of 2026
headline.summary: Tokyo will host SusHi Tech 2026, focusing on four key technology domains with live demonstrations and dedicated exhibit spaces. The event aims to showcase innovations and connect builders and investors in the global tech landscape.

articles.title: Apple under Ternus: what comes next for the tech giant’s hardware strategy
articles.summary: John Ternus, Apple's new CEO, is expected to refocus the company's strategy on hardware development, emphasizing the importance of devices in Apple's future plans. This shift may lead to a renewed emphasis on innovation and product offerings within the tech giant's hardware lineup.

articles.title: OpenAI CEO apologizes to Tumbler Ridge community
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman issued an apology to the Tumbler Ridge community for the company's failure to notify law enforcement regarding a suspect linked to a recent mass shooting. In his letter, he expressed his deep regret for the oversight.

articles.title: Discord Sleuths Gained Unauthorized Access to Anthropic’s Mythos
articles.summary: Discord users gained unauthorized access to Anthropic's AI model, Mythos, raising concerns about security and data privacy. In related news, spy firms are exploiting vulnerabilities in global telecom networks, and 500,000 UK health records have been listed for sale on Alibaba.

articles.title: Why Cohere is merging with Aleph Alpha
articles.summary: Cohere, a Canadian AI startup, is merging with Germany-based Aleph Alpha, backed by Lidl's owner, Schwarz Group. The partnership aims to provide a sovereign alternative for enterprises in the AI sector, which is largely influenced by American companies.

articles.title: Ace the Ping-Pong Robot Can Whup Your Ass
articles.summary: The Ace ping-pong robot is designed to analyze the trajectory of a ball and adjust its racket angle to engage in realistic matches with human players. Its advanced technology allows it to maintain an ongoing exchange, showcasing significant improvements in robotic sports interaction.

articles.title: 8 Gemini tips for organizing your space (and life)
articles.summary: The article provides eight practical tips for utilizing Gemini to enhance organization in both personal space and daily life. It highlights features like document management and checklist tools to streamline tasks and improve productivity.

articles.title: Three reasons why DeepSeek’s new model matters
articles.summary: Chinese AI firm DeepSeek has previewed its new flagship model, V4, which features an improved design allowing it to process significantly longer prompts than its predecessor. The model remains open source, continuing the company's commitment to accessibility in AI development.

articles.title: ComfyUI hits $500M valuation as creators seek more control over AI-generated media
articles.summary: ComfyUI has achieved a valuation of $500 million following a $30 million funding round aimed at enhancing creators' control over AI-generated media, including images, videos, and audio. The company's tools are designed to empower users in the content creation process.

articles.title: M-CARE: Standardized Clinical Case Reporting for AI Model Behavioral Disorders, with a 20-Case Atlas and Experimental Validation
articles.summary: The article introduces M-CARE, a standardized clinical case reporting framework designed for evaluating AI model behavioral disorders, modeled after human medical practices. It features a comprehensive report format, a diagnostic assessment system, and a classification of AI behavioral conditions, supported by 20 case studies from various observational and experimental sources.

articles.title: Planetary Exploration 3.0: A Roadmap for Software-Defined, Radically Adaptive Space Systems
articles.summary: The article discusses a proposed roadmap for advancing planetary exploration through software-defined and adaptive space systems, emphasizing the need to explore the largely uncharted surfaces and subsurfaces of celestial bodies beyond Mars. It critiques the traditional incremental approach of NASA's Mars missions and suggests a shift towards more innovative strategies to address fundamental questions in planetary science.

articles.title: Integrated packing, placement, scheduling, and routing of personalized production: a pharmaceutical Industry 4.0 use-case with a planar transport system
articles.summary: The article discusses the integration of packing, placement, scheduling, and routing in personalized production within the pharmaceutical sector, utilizing a planar transport system. It highlights how this innovative approach can enhance Flexible Manufacturing Systems (FMS) by improving efficiency through independent movers operating on a tile-based planar grid.
